# Colophon {.unnumbered}

This book was produced with [Quarto](https://quarto.org),
typeset in [Source Serif 4](https://fonts.adobe.com/fonts/source-serif),
with code blocks set in [JetBrains
Mono](https://www.jetbrains.com/lp/mono/). The command
examples target Quarto 1.5 or later and a recent R
installation with the `rmarkdown` and `knitr` packages.

The book is hosted at <https://rmd-to-quarto.rgtlab.org>
on Netlify, with continuous deployment via GitHub Actions
from the `rgt47/rmd-to-quarto` repository on every push to
`main`.

The cover is generated procedurally by
`images/build-cover.R` from a watercolor gradient anchored
on `#39729e` (the volume's brand blue) and overlaid with
Avenir typography. Re-running the script regenerates the
cover; the procedural approach makes the cover reproducible
and editable in version control rather than dependent on a
one-shot image-generation step. That the cover of a book
about reproducible authoring is itself a versioned, scripted
artifact is deliberate.

Last rendered: see the build timestamp on the homepage.
